desc: Build an exact minimax oracle for small N (<=5) and small A_i (<=4 or 5) to enumerate winners and test whether the outcome depends only on N and the number of odd A_i (or other parity categories).
Compute count-state DP tables for small sizes to reveal a closed-form pattern.
Prove that pass count only matters modulo 2, with careful treatment of zero versus positive even pass counts.
Identify and verify exceptional small cases, especially N = 1, N = 2, and N = 3.
Derive and prove the initial-state winning rule, including small-N exceptions, from the base/induction.
Implement O(N) input parsing, count odd A_i, apply the proven rule, and print Fennec/Snuke.
Validate the rule against the brute-force oracle and the provided samples.
